proposed_comments.title: Keep provider-specific logging safe in the shared exporter

confidence.rationale: Logger::logger is a mutable process-global shared_ptr. Each exported provider now calls Logger::init with its own logger name and file from the same DLL, so concurrent Explorer activations can replace the active sink while another provider is logging. The fork correction serializes provider initialization and log writes.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep provider-specific logging safe in the shared exporter

**Severity:** `high`

The consolidated DLL now serves every preview and thumbnail provider in one process, but each provider constructor reinitializes the mutable process-global logger with a different file. Concurrent Explorer activations can therefore replace the active logger while another handler is writing, which misroutes diagnostics and races the shared logger pointer. Please retain each provider's logger identity and serialize initialization together with every log operation, or make the logger instance-scoped.

This requires coordinated changes across the preview and thumbnail handlers, so it is a general review note rather than an unsafe partial apply suggestion.

proposed_comments.title: Release preview handler handles

confidence.rationale: The new shared PreviewHandler creates a resize-event handle and retains a child-process handle, while its destructor only decrements the DLL reference count. The current code closes neither handle.

proposed_comments.title: Close the completed thumbnail process handle

confidence.rationale: SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS transfers a process handle into sei.hProcess. The handler waits for it and then overwrites or abandons m_process without CloseHandle, directly leaking a handle for every thumbnail request.
